context: Saturday morning. Yumiko is signing a permission slip. Hina hovers, dramatic, ready to defend her case.
purpose: tiny domestic logistics — kid lobbying mom

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: お母さん、これ、はやくサインして！
lines.style: Shoves the paper in front of her, bouncing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Pen already in hand. Reading even while signing.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah! I really want to go!
lines.style: Adds the lobbying even after she's being signed up. Eight-year-old logic.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Half-laugh. The mom-voice of someone who has done this thirty times.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ありがとうお母さん大好き！
lines.style: All one breath, full kid-volume. Already running off in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日のうちに、ランドセル準備してね？
lines.en: Get your school-bag ready today, okay?
lines.style: Calls after her in the voice. Pragmatic afterword.
